### Exercise 1

Insert any text here.

```{r code-chunk-label}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(viridis)

coc_data <- read_csv("coc_data 1.csv")

gis_files <- st_read("stupid_simple_GIS.shp")

# 1. Read and prepare shapefile with proper CRS handling
coc_shapes <- st_read("C:/Users/yahya/OneDrive/Bureau/data_and_society/Continuum_of_Care_Grantee_Areas.shp") %>% 
  rename(coc_num = COCNUM) %>% 
  st_transform(4326)  # Convert to standard WGS84 lat/lon for better compatibility

# 2. Join with spending data - ensure matching data types
coc_map_data <- coc_shapes %>% 
  left_join(coc_data_1 %>% mutate(coc_num = as.character(coc_num)), 
            by = "coc_num") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(funding_tot))  # Remove areas with no spending data

# 3. Create optimized static plot
map_plot <- ggplot(coc_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = funding_tot,
              text = paste("<b>", coc_name, "</b>",
                          "<br>Spending:", scales::dollar(funding_tot))),
          color = NA,  # Remove borders for cleaner look
          lwd = 0) +   # No line width
  scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = scales::dollar_format(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),  # Format in millions
    name = "Total Spending ($M)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Continuum of Care Program Spending")

# 4. Create interactive plot with performance optimizations
interactive_map <- ggplotly(map_plot, tooltip = "text", height = 700) %>%
  plotly::layout(
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      y = -0.1,
      xanchor = "center",
      x = 0.5
    ),
    margin = list(t = 40)  # Add top margin for title
  ) %>% 
  plotly::config(
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    scrollZoom = TRUE  # Enable zoom with mouse scroll
  )

# Display the map
interactive_map
```
